points.quote: A service identifier is created with `createDecorator<T>('name')` (`instantiation.ts:109`). Convention: the const and the interface share one name
the service is declared as a constructor parameter with the decorator, e.g. `constructor(arg: string, @IFooService private readonly fooService: IFooService)`
`instantiationService.createInstance(MyClass, ...staticArgs)` resolves the dependencies and builds the object.
It is typically called at module top level in a workbench contribution or service file.
